purpose: Offline-fallback fixture for the pricing-drift-check detector. The detector primarily fetches the live page; this snapshot lets it (a) stay useful when the live fetch fails — fail-open — and (b) detect when the snapshot itself has gone stale (> 90 days = warning, prompts re-capture). Re-capture and commit this file whenever you confirm Anthropic's published rates against the dashboard, AND whenever the detector reports drift that resolves to a real Anthropic price change.

cache_multipliers.note: All cache rates derive from these multipliers applied to base input. Documented on the source page under '### Prompt caching'. Detector validates that pricing.toml's stored values are consistent with these multipliers AND with the absolute values in the model-pricing table.
